# Integration Reliability & Test Synchronization Checklist: Fix Client Test Flakiness

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of requirements for eliminating flakiness, race conditions, and fragile synchronization in client integration tests.
**Created**: 2026-08-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all test methods requiring unskipping or stabilization explicitly enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the exact exception types expected upon session expiration (`SessionExpiredError`) documented for all queued operations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Contract: client-queue.md]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the post-reconnect requirements defined for subsequent requests submitted after a new session is established? [Completeness, Spec §US1, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Are specific requirements specified for handling the state transition sequence (`LOST` -> `CONNECTING` -> `CONNECTED`) during session rejection? [Completeness, DataModel: data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the cleanup requirement for internal client state (`_session_id`, `_session_passwd`, `_queue`, `_pending`) fully defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, DataModel: data-model.md]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [ ] CHK006 Is "flakiness" and "determinism" quantified with concrete pass-rate thresholds and repetition counts (e.g., 50 consecutive runs)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the synchronization boundaries between connection thread event dispatch and test thread assertions unambiguous? [Clarity, Contract: client-queue.md]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the distinction between session recovery (preserving existing session ID) and session expiration (re-establishing a new session ID) explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §US1, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the exact mechanism for password mutation specified in terms of byte representation and state timing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Research §Decision 1]
- [ ] CHK010 Are all timeout windows defined as bounded maximums rather than arbitrary fixed delays? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Plan §Technical Context]

## Requirement Consistency & Alignment

- [ ] CHK011 Do the request queuing requirements in the specification align consistently with the behavioral contracts in `contracts/client-queue.md`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Contract: client-queue.md]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the state transitions defined in `data-model.md` fully consistent with Kazoo's dual-state model (`KeeperState` vs `KazooState`)? [Consistency, DataModel: data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK013 Do the test synchronization rules avoid conflicting with the asynchronous notification semantics of `KazooClient.add_listener`? [Consistency, Contract: client-queue.md]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the requirements for Docker Compose container stop/start lifecycles consistent between plain and capture test modes? [Consistency, Spec §US3, Contract: capture-inspection.md]

## Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [ ] CHK015 Can the pass criteria for `test_request_queuing_session_expired` be objectively verified without inspecting internal socket internals? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Contract: client-queue.md]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the validation procedure for network capture artifacts objectively defined with specific frame filters and field expectations? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, Contract: capture-inspection.md]
- [ ] CHK017 Can 100% pass-rate verification over repeated executions be automated in CI via standard test tooling (`pytest --count`)? [Measurability, Quickstart: quickstart.md]
- [ ] CHK018 Are quality gate criteria for linting (`flake8`, `black`) and strict typing (`mypy`) objectively testable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005, Constitution §V]

## Scenario & Lifecycle Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for the happy-path recovery flow where a suspended client's server restarts with session intact? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for the exception flow where a suspended client's session is rejected by the server on reconnect? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for multiple consecutive async requests queued while in the suspended state? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements specified for failover scenarios when one ensemble member stops while remaining nodes remain healthy? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for client connection socket shutdown vs graceful stop/close lifecycles? [Coverage, Spec §US4]

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- [ ] CHK024 Does the specification define expected behavior if a container restart exceeds standard startup latency (e.g. slow CI runner)? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements specified for handling race conditions between socket writes and immediate client closure? [Edge Cases, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK026 Does the specification address behavior when session password mangling occurs during active socket reconnection vs prior to container restart? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §Decision 1]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for handling `SessionClosedRequireSaslError` or auth-specific reconnect states during session invalidation? [Edge Cases, Gap]

## Dependencies, Handlers & Concurrency

- [ ] CHK028 Are synchronization requirements portable across all supported handler backends (`threading`, `gevent`, `eventlet`)? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-008, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements documented for event object creation and signaling using `client.handler.event_object()` rather than standard library threading primitives? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-006, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK030 Are assumptions regarding Docker Compose test harness dependencies (`testcontainers`, ZooKeeper 3.5+) explicitly recorded? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK031 Are network capture sidecar dependencies (`tshark`, PCAP directory permissions) clearly documented as non-blocking for standard test runs? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Contract: capture-inspection.md]

## Traceability & Governance

- [ ] CHK032 Does every user story trace directly to functional requirements and verifiable success criteria? [Traceability, Spec §US1-US4, Spec §FR-001-007, Spec §SC-001-005]
- [ ] CHK033 Are constitutional quality gates (strict type checking, test-first sequencing, changelog recording) integrated into the task plan? [Traceability, Constitution §II, Constitution §V, Tasks §Phase 7]
